method: Bank common-equity residual income, no FCFF or industrial net-debt bridge
preferred_common_bridge: No preferred equity line in consolidated balance sheet; junior subordinated trust securities are liabilities and already affect interest expense. Do not subtract funding deposits from equity value.
fcfe_formula: Normalized common earnings - increase in required regulatory equity - stress retention + separately authorized distributable excess; reconcile cash available at holding.
diagnostic_formula: BPS*(ROE-g)/(Ke-g), perpetual steady-state common-book RI; not approved forecast
restrictions: Common book pairs with ROE, never tangible book with total-equity ROE. No buyback value added independently of capital decrease/share change. SBC retained as expense.
